answer: An farming party hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The dawn schedule is applied in trellis and vault makes public each instalment. A payout is split and as a result 53% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3891 identities would post 3690 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
